definitions.window: All statistics use daily returns from EVAL_START to EVAL_END (inclusive).
definitions.vol: standard deviation of daily returns (ddof=1) times sqrt(252).
definitions.sharpe: mean daily return in excess of the daily risk-free rate (Fama-French RF; zero if unavailable) times 252, divided by vol.
definitions.max_drawdown: most negative peak-to-trough change of the wealth curve, which starts at 1; reported as a negative number.
definitions.relative: strategy_net minus the benchmark, computed on calendar-month compounded returns; t-statistic and se are Newey-West (Bartlett) with lags = holding_months; ci95 = mean +/- 1.96 se; annualized_diff = 12 * mean monthly difference; cagr_diff = cagr difference.
definitions.beta_vs_spy: OLS slope of daily strategy_net on daily spy.
definitions.alpha: four-factor regression of daily (strategy_net - rf) on mkt_rf, smb, hml, mom; Newey-West lags = 21 * holding_months; alpha_annual = daily intercept * 252.
definitions.spanning: four-factor regression of daily (strategy_net - ew_universe) on mkt_rf, smb, hml, mom; same lags; a positive alpha means the strategy adds return beyond the equal-weight universe and factor exposures.
definitions.turnover: portfolio_value.turnover on execution days (one-way, as written by the engine); the first execution day (initial build from cash) is excluded.
definitions.costs: total_cost = sum of trades.cost over the window; pct_of_avg_value = total_cost / mean net_value; annualized divides by years = n_days / 252.
definitions.holdings: mean_n_holdings = mean of portfolio_value.n_holdings; max_weight = largest single weight in holdings.parquet; mean_hhi = mean over dates of the sum of squared weights.
definitions.capacity: per trade, participation = |trade value| * fund_aum / (20-day average dollar volume of the ticker, close * volume, ending the prior trading day); fund_aum scales the backtest's $1 book to the stated fund size. per_trade gives mean, median, 95th/99th percentile and max over trades (max_trade names the worst one); per_day_sum sums participations across the trades of one execution day. Trades without 20 days of volume history are counted in n_missing_adv and excluded.
definitions.cost_grid: strategy_net re-run at each cost in bps (0, 10, 25); alpha_t is the four-factor alpha t-statistic.
definitions.subperiods: first = EVAL_START to the day before SUBPERIOD_SPLIT; second = SUBPERIOD_SPLIT to EVAL_END; rel_ew_t is the Newey-West t of strategy_net minus ew_universe (monthly, lags = holding_months).
definitions.groups: group_k = k-th ranked group (1 = lowest signal), net of costs; mean_monthly = mean of monthly compounded returns; cagr_daily from daily compounding; rho = Spearman correlation of group index with mean monthly return; expected_rho_sign is -1 when favored='lowest' and expected_sign='favored_group_higher' (or favored='highest' with 'favored_group_lower'), +1 for the other two cases; rho_in_expected_direction = rho * expected_rho_sign > 0 (null when expected_sign is unclear or rho undefined). favored_minus_disfavored is the mean monthly difference between the favored end group and the opposite end group with its Newey-West t.
definitions.universe_sensitivity: not computed here; the pipeline may fill it.
